target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (A B T Q : P), A ∈ s → B ∈ s → Q ∈ line[ℝ, A, B] → Q ≠ T → s.IsTangentAt T line[ℝ, Q, T] → dist Q T ^ 2 = dist Q A * dist Q B
